newsitem.title: USA: Lower deposit costs to boost Astoria EPS.
newsitem.headline: Lower deposit costs to boost Astoria EPS.

text.p: Astoria Financial Corp said on Thursday a lower deposit insurance assessment expense would add about $4.3 million or $0.20 per share after tax to annual earnings begining in 1997.
The lower assessment was part of recent U.S. legislation which mandated banks recapatilize their share of the Savings Association Insurance Fund.

The bank also said its loan loss provision for the first nine months of 1996 rose to $3.5 million compared to $2.2 million for the same period last year. This was due to the increase in the loan portfolio after record loan originations and purchases, the bank said.
